problem: VisualWorkerRuntime._initialize_local stores _local_original and calls _register_local_original before initialize_visual_bootstrap_if_absent.
Registration checks genuine initialization caller, owner live app and exact original description, then stores owner->runtime. Registration does not require adoption.
bind_step_grounding scans tuple(_LOCAL_RUNTIMES.values()) and eagerly calls runtime.original.digest on every entry.
VisualWorkerRuntime.original first calls supervision_source_publication, whose absence raises RuntimeError.

A distinct registered unadopted runtime is therefore reachable in the scan and can abort otherwise valid target grounding. The scan can also read another owner/thread source before selecting the intended owner.
evidence_class: Static reachable candidate defect only; no runtime failure or executed reproduction asserted.
root_cause: Selection invokes live getters on all registered runtimes despite registration preceding adoption, conflating sealed identity lookup with adopted publication availability.

target.allowed: Local branch runtime selection/validation and associated local imports only.

design: Two-stage lookup using existing sealed descriptor registry, then exact genuine selected-owner/runtime checks and app liveness, then selected durable original equality and unchanged private binding. Description matching is never authority.

sequence.action: Review original finding and input hashes, selected bind_step_grounding pin and read-only dependency applicability, then activate same Sol. Existing R340 exact successor/evidence and other R331 work are preserved. No whole-file rollback.

In the existing local branch only, compute desired canonical descriptor using operational_windows._json(original.local_time.to_payload()) (alias it to avoid owner_registration._json confusion). Iterate a snapshot of _LOCAL_RUNTIMES.items(); shortlist owner/runtime pairs solely by _LOCAL_ORIGINALS.get(owner)==desired. No runtime.original/publication/bootstrap/episode_id/is_adopted or repository/clock getter may run while scanning. Require exactly one pair before any live candidate validation; empty or duplicate matches reject.

For that unique pair, validate exact OperationalWindowOwner and VisualWorkerRuntime types, runtime._operational_owner is owner, both registry mappings still match the pair/descriptor, _OWNERS.get(startup.worker) is owner, not owner._closed, captured startup mode LOCAL and thread_id equals threading.get_ident(). Compare captured startup job/run/attempt/lease/worker-id tuple to current_identity; runtime source job repository and id tuple, role_binding and _local_session must match actual startup worker/repository/binding/session. Compare both owner._local_original and runtime._local_original canonical descriptions to the sealed descriptor; original.source_hashes must match runtime.source.source_hashes. These are selected-object checks only; reject any mismatch without seeking another candidate.

Call selected owner._check_app_live() before first selected original/publication getter, retaining genuine original source/issuer/thread/clock/hard-bound expiry checks. Only then fetch selected runtime.original, require its exact LocalVisualOriginalPlan type, full identity equality with current_identity and original.identity, digest equality with requested original, local_time canonical equality to sealed descriptor and source-hash equality. Do not catch its missing/incoherent/stale publication exceptions or use a serialized value as fallback authority.

Call that same selected runtime._local_bind_grounding with the unchanged payload and observation, from bind_step_grounding itself so the existing caller-code guard remains valid. Preserve all earlier deterministic policy/checkpoint/cursor/duration checks and all downstream publication/frame/window/job-event-lock/receipt/transaction/replay validation. No new public selector parameter, capability or runtime registration.

Save minimal source diff and before/after canonical target segments; use stdlib AST/symtable/source/hash only. Independently inspect order/data flow and the case matrix, unchanged call frame/payload, unchanged nonlocal branch, unchanged _local_bind_grounding/registration/getter/owner-check bodies and all non-target bytes versus immediate baseline. Save static step/acceptance reports; no tests/probe/import/collection. Carry accepted target hash into later original GREEN gate preparation, not execution release.

verification_case_matrix.case: Unrelated registered bootstrap runtime, same or different thread, any registry order
verification_case_matrix.proof: Its sealed descriptor differs; no runtime getter, repository or clock source is read for it.

verification_case_matrix.case: Genuine unique adopted matching owner on original thread
verification_case_matrix.proof: All exact registry/startup/source/app checks precede selected live original digest and existing private binding.

verification_case_matrix.case: Zero matching registrations or copied/forged serialized original
verification_case_matrix.proof: No match rejects; descriptor match alone still cannot bypass registry/type/startup/thread/app/durable original checks.
Count check rejects before either live getter; no first-match or exception-based fallback.

verification_case_matrix.case: Matching target is closed, expired, revoked, foreign-thread, source/session drifted or pre-adoption
verification_case_matrix.proof: Strict selected checks and owner._check_app_live reject, or selected original getter reports unavailable; no fallback/swallowing.
Existing _local_bind_grounding and two-authority locked checks remain unchanged; no snapshot promoted to authority.

limits: No whole-source replacement from historical snapshots; preserve R340 exact cap successor and unrelated definitions.
Do not move/register extra runtimes, change adopt/publication semantics, loosen original or receipt checks, add tests or blanket exception handlers.
No product imports/calls, numerical probe, pytest/collection, clock/runtime execution or new commands/attempt budgets.
Read-only snapshot inputs are historical evidence; mutable full files are not rollback preconditions. Review relevant dependency/source applicability before activation.
A new cause, unexpected metadata failure or widened scope pauses affected repair for new Astra; do not implement a broader fix under this plan.
runtime_prerequisites: None for source-only repair. ROOT activation and applicable selected source pins required for implementation. All existing original R331 actor/source/HEAD/resource and applicable correction gates remain required before GREEN; this plan does not authorize arbitrary HEAD drift or runtime.
acceptance: Source-only isolation of lookup, preservation of live authority and all existing binding checks. No runtime pass, T3/B-final completion or C/native/model/physics claim.
